Proposition
[Three-dimensional Harnack equivalence] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0126, page-0127 ↗ cor:chow-iii-2d-harnack 1. ch19:19.44\group Low Dimensions

Every three-dimensional $\kappa $-solution with Harnack has bounded curvature. If the curvature operator is not positive, the universal cover splits off a line and reduces to the two-dimensional classification; in the positive case, an unbounded-curvature blow-up splits to a round shrinking cylinder, yielding a contradiction.
